item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Experimental and modelling analysis of physico-chemical and transport properties of ionic exchange membranes (Univ. PALERMO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-25 23:59
Institution: Univ. PALERMO, Palermo
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/ICHI-01 Sistemi, metodi e tecnologie dell'ingegneria chimica e di processo

This research activity focuses on the experimental characterization and modeling of ion-exchange membranes to assess physicochemical and transport properties. The experimental phase involves investigating key parameters such as ionic conductivity, osmotic water flux, permselectivity, and chemical stability under diverse operational conditions. In parallel, advanced theoretical and numerical models based on Stephan-Maxwell approach have to be developed and validated against experimental data to simulate mass transport mechanisms and predict membrane behavior. The integration of these two approaches aims to optimize membrane performance for application in advanced energy storage and…

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Design and evaluation of a blood pump to support the Fontan circulation - 2026_CDR_DCMC_5 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IBIO-01 Bioingegneria

Single ventricle defects are among the most severe forms of congenital heart disease and are palliated through a series of surgeries culminating in the Fontan procedure. Although patient survival is substantially improved, progressive circulatory failure may develop over time, requiring heart support. However, current ventricular assist devices are poorly suited to the unique physiology of the Fontan circulation. To address this unmet clinical need, this project will investigate the feasibility of a minimally invasive pump designed for chronic Fontan support without requiring additional open-heart surgery. Computational modelling will be used to: i) develop the structural design of a…

item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Agentic EEG Interfaces for Screen-Independent Assistive Communication in ALS - 2026_CDR_DEIB_13 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-12-03 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IBIO-01 Bioingegneria

This project aims to develop a non-invasive, screen-independent EEG communication system for people with ALS who struggle with speech, movement, or eye-tracking tools. It will detect intentional attempts to communicate through imagined words or short phrases and identify messages from a personalized vocabulary of around 20 essential expressions. A constrained AI assistant will manage uncertainty, request confirmation, offer alternatives, and convey confirmed messages while keeping users in control. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Autonomous Cislunar Relative Orbit control for CubeSats (ACRO-Cube) - 2026_CDR_DAER_4 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-20 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-01 Ingegneria aerospaziale e navale

ACRO-Cube aims to enable safe and fuel-efficient station-keeping of CubeSats – small, low-cost satellites roughly the size of a shoebox – flying in formation in cislunar space, the vast and dynamically complex region between the Earth and the Moon. The project pursues three objectives: (1) Derive and verify less nonlinear relative orbital dynamics models, based on spherical and action-angle variables, to capture the chaotic nature of cislunar trajectories and reduce error growth, (2) Design and validate a tube-based predictive controller that is robust to model uncertainties and environmental perturbations, while remaining compatible with the limited propulsion and onboard computing…

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-20 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-03 Telecomunicazioni

The research activity will investigate novel system architectures for accelerating the network stack of data-center-class applications. The work will focus on the co-design of operating-system mechanisms, networking software, and programmable hardware accelerators to improve the performance and efficiency of high-throughput, data-intensive workloads. A key objective will be to identify network-processing functions that can benefit from hardware acceleration while retaining flexibility and programmability. The research will explore extensions to operating systems and networking stacks that enable applications to exploit hardware acceleration capabilities available in novel NIC architectures.…

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-01 Ingegneria aerospaziale e navale

This research activity focuses on developing innovative methodologies and techniques for verifying and validating scientific cameras and their acquisition chains. It will define experimental procedures, quantitative metrics, and models to characterize optical, radiometric, and functional performance, assess the quality and reliability of payload science data, and quantify uncertainties associated with the instrumentation, observation scenarios, and data-processing chain. item.title: Contratto di ricerca: Mechanical characterization of planetary surfaces - 2026_CDR_DAER_3 (Politecnico MILANO)
item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-14 12:00
Institution: Politecnico MILANO, Milan
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IIND-01 Ingegneria aerospaziale e navale

The objective of this position is to define a methodology and instrumentation architecture for characterizing the mechanical properties of planetary surfaces in a space environment. Planned applications include in-situ surface exploration scenarios for Solar System small bodies, including lunar and asteroid missions. The position will involve numerical modeling, laboratory experimental activities, prototyping and instrumentation development, and data analysis.

item.description:
Deadline: 2026-11-23 23:59
Institution: Univ. Bocconi MILANO, Milano
Field: Industrial and information engineering / 09/IINF-05 Sistemi di elaborazione delle informazioni

E4RL aims to turn videos of human activities into a resource for training robots, reducing reliance on manually designed simulations and costly robotic data collection. The project will convert first-person videos into egocentric 4D representations: 3D reconstructions of the scene and its evolution over time. It will recover the structure of the environment, the objects involved, and the person’s pose and motion, describing where elements are located, how they are used, and what role they play in completing tasks.
